scope: Frozen 100-epoch voxel baseline versus 200-epoch Haar run; existing results, no new training.
model_selection: Lowest full-volume patient-macro validation MAE within each run budget; test not used for checkpoint selection.
volume_evaluation: full preprocessed volume; range=1; final clamp; patient macro mean; PSNR MSE floor=1e-12

projection_evaluation.grid: Same Z256 reference grid for both models
projection_evaluation.layer_labels: Ground-truth layers used only after inference to calculate projections; not generator inputs
projection_evaluation.enhanced_display: Independent [0,P99] for each panel; morphology inspection only
projection_evaluation.center_crop: Fixed central 128x128 pixels; not selected by visual quality

example_selection.sort_key: haar3d volume MAE minus voxel volume MAE, ascending
example_selection.purpose: Show the range of observed changes; descriptive selection after evaluation, not an independent validation set

privacy: Metric tables use bundle-local sample labels; five pre-existing example figures retain public dataset case numbers. No demographic labels, identity mappings, patient manifests or local machine paths are included.
limitations: Unequal total training budgets: 100 versus 200 epochs
Does not include subsequent baseline-200 evaluations
No model weights or raw volumes; exported metrics can be rechecked but inference cannot be rerun from this bundle alone
